payload.text: record-hygiene D1's git/sofar exemption applies only when EVERY segment of a compound command is git or sofar — isSelfRecordingCommand uses segments.every(). So `git push origin main | tail -3`, `git diff && echo ...`, and `git commit -F - <<'EOF'` with a prose heredoc all DO get recorded as command_run, and the tree is dirty again the instant it is clean. To settle the tree at wrap-up, run git bare and unpiped: `git add -A && git commit -m "..."` (quoted message, no heredoc, no pipe), then `git push origin main` on its own.

tot=0; reads=0; lead=collections.Counter()
for p in glob.glob('.sofar/initiatives/*/events.jsonl'):
    for l in open(p):
        l=l.strip()
        if not l: continue
        try: e=json.loads(l)
        except: continue
        if e.get('type')!='command_run': continue
        cmd=e.get('payload',{}).get('cmd','')
        tot+=1
        # leading token of the whole command
        m=re.match(r'\s*(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*=\S+\s+)*([^\s|&;<>()]+)',cmd)
        t=(m.group(1).split('/')[-1] if m else '?')
        lead[t]+=1
        # "read-only" = every segment leads with a read tool
        segs=[s for s in re.split(r'&&|\|\||;|\||\n',cmd) if s.strip()]
        ok=True
        for s in segs:
            mm=re.match(r'\s*(?:[A-Za-z_]\w*=\S+\s+)*([^\s|&;<>()]+)',s)
            tk=(mm.group(1).split('/')[-1] if mm else '?')
            if tk not in READ: ok=False; break
        if ok and segs: reads+=1
print(f"command_run total: {tot}")
print(f"all-segments-read-only: {reads} ({100*reads//tot}%)")
print("top leading tokens:", lead.most_common(14))
EOF
